spanish: Todo el ganado al holocausto: doce toros, carneros doce, corderos hijos de año doce, y su minjá; y machos cabríos de cabras doce a pecado.

findings.issue: al adds a definite article; the morphology is preposition plus absolute noun, with no article
minjá leaves the common noun untranslated; a common noun stays Spanish
The colon list reads the rams and lambs as the contents of todo el ganado; the cattle token is tallied by the twelve bulls, and the ram and lamb phrases stand apart
findings.spanishSpan: Todo el ganado al holocausto: doce toros, carneros doce, corderos hijos de año doce

notes: The four twelves, sons-of-year, singular offering with a plural suffix, and a pecado match the token sequence.
